title: 真题演练 · 非谓语作定语
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 非谓语作定语。

questions.q: The book ___ on the desk belongs to Tom.
questions.analysis: lying 表主动进行,"躺/平放"的不及物用法。

questions.q: The problems ___ at the meeting will be solved next week.
questions.analysis: problems 被讨论,用过去分词 discussed。

questions.q: She was the first woman ___ the mountain.
questions.analysis: the first 后接 to do 作定语。

questions.q: The students ___ from Class 3 won the game.
questions.analysis: 主动进行,coming 相当于 who came。

questions.q: I have nothing ___ about the plan.
questions.analysis: nothing + to do,不定式作定语表将来。

questions.q: 判断对错:The window breaking last night has been repaired.
questions.analysis: 应改为:The window broken last night has been repaired.。窗户是"被打破"的,要用过去分词 broken,不是主动的 breaking。
